checks: Full suite: 1,693 passed, zero failed or skipped, including 12 documented expected-failure cases; 95.72 seconds. Evidence: [final-full-suite.json](test-audit/evidence/final-full-suite.json).

Coverage run: 1,693 passed with the configured thresholds satisfied. Statements 69.83%, branches 59.9%, functions 77.82%, lines 71.75%. These numbers describe instrumented code only. Evidence: [coverage summary](test-audit/evidence/final-coverage-summary.json) and [run log](test-audit/evidence/final-coverage.log).

Docker setup: all six cases passed in 23.912 seconds. The two real CLI CI scenarios passed in 1.775 and 0.612 seconds. Evidence: [Docker](test-audit/evidence/final-docker-setup.json), [multi-project](test-audit/evidence/final-ci-multi-project.json), [local storage](test-audit/evidence/final-ci-local-storage.json).

Typecheck passed. Lint passed with 23 warnings. Knip failed on three unused application exports, listed below. Evidence: [static checks](test-audit/evidence/final-static-checks.json), [lint output](test-audit/evidence/final-lint.log), [Knip output](test-audit/evidence/final-knip.log).
The newly-added-file coverage check passed against the pinned baseline because the audit adds no application modules.

All 1,748 original declarations, 1,532 current declarations and 1,693 runtime cases reconcile with zero action, classification, source-body, or mutation-proof gaps. Every original WEAK/HOLLOW rating has a surviving fault or explicit structural reason. Evidence: [ledger](test-audit/ledger.json) and [source/runtime reconciliation](test-audit/reconciliation.json).

All 11 defects were reproduced with ordinary failing tests; all 12 expected-failure cases are linked to those defects. Each inverse repair probe makes its expected-failure case report an unexpected pass.
Application source, prompts and extension code match the baseline, with no untracked application files. Evidence: [source integrity](test-audit/evidence/final-source-integrity.json).

The rerunnable AST reconciliation checker passed 10 controlled scenarios. The report generator also rejected stale runtime evidence before writing output. Evidence: [reconciliation self-check](test-audit/evidence/reconcile-selfcheck.json), [stale-report check](test-audit/evidence/report-stale-runtime-rejected.json).

Behavior-over-implementation removed the CLI source-concatenation helper and source-marker assertions. Build-the-lever produced the inventory, mutation, reconciliation and report scripts used for the final checks.

blockers.description: Knip exits 1 for src/lib/remoteWizard.ts:661 (__test), src/lib/setup/summary.ts:370 (__test), and src/lib/setupKeys.ts:716 (setupKeysTestHooks). Their test consumers were removed. Deleting these now-unused exports would change application code, which this audit forbids. The CI dead-code job therefore remains failing; no ignore was added to hide it.

Live provider services and credentials, native keychain/scheduler integration, a running VS Code extension host, and physical network-share behavior were not exercised. Tests use local HTTP, external-boundary doubles, subprocesses and temporary local storage. The feature matrix names these limits.

Verification ran on local macOS with Node 22.17.1 and in the setup Docker image. Other configured Linux/macOS Node 20/22/24 matrix combinations and remote GitHub Actions were not run; no push or PR was authorized.

The pre-existing new-file coverage script exits successfully when its base ref cannot be resolved and omits files absent from its coverage summary. The explicit pinned-base check passed here, but this does not establish coverage for excluded modules. See COLL-03 and coverage_scope in test-audit/collection.json.
